description: Log runs with distance and time — pace stats and weekly totals computed automatically.

faqs.a: Enter the date, distance in km and the time (h:mm:ss or mm:ss), then click Log Run. Pace is computed automatically.
faqs.q: How do I log a run?

faqs.a: Pace is shown as minutes:seconds per km. Average pace is weighted by distance.
Runs are grouped by calendar week (Monday–Sunday) showing total distance and run count.
In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.

howto: See pace per run, your stats and weekly totals below.
Delete mistaken entries with the Delete button.
title: Running Log
